scope_summary: New multi-lot subdivision requiring full site servicing, watermain, sanitary sewer, storm drainage, grading and roadworks.
Watermain and sanitary sewer replacement with road restoration and curb and gutter for an infill servicing project.
Road and utility site servicing including storm sewer, forcemain, manhole installation and earthworks for an industrial parcel.
Rezoning and land development for a multi-family residential project with associated site servicing and utility connections.
Storm drainage culvert replacement and detention pond construction with trench and pipe works.
Interior tenant improvement of an existing office suite including mechanical, electrical and HVAC alterations.
Sanitary sewer forcemain extension and lift station upgrade with underground utility works.
New freestanding commercial sign permit; no site or servicing work.
